theme_rankings.why_now: AI가 돌아가려면 전기 필요. 미국 변압기 대기 100주+ → 만드는 회사들 5년치 일감 확보.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 후반 진입 우려는 아직 작지만, 금리 급등 시 인프라주 동반 조정.

theme_rankings.why_now: HBM4·CoWoS·EUV 모두 캐파 부족 지속. 2027까지 수요 가시성 확보된 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 정점 논쟁 + 중국 수출 규제 변동성. 어닝 미스 시 30% 낙폭 흔함.

theme_rankings.why_now: MSFT·GOOG·META·AMZN 2026 Capex 합계 $400B+. AI 매출 회수 본격화 단계.
theme_rankings.risk: 광고·소비 둔화 시 Capex 가이던스 컷 가능. 빅테크 동반 변동성.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🚂 AI의 '밴더빌트' — 실제 업무에 AI 박는 운영자
theme_rankings.why_now: 추론 비용 90% 하락 + 엔터프라이즈 도입 본격. 진짜 텐베거 후보가 여기서 다수.
theme_rankings.risk: 밸류에이션 과열. 매출 성장 30%+ 못 보이면 멀티플 압축.

theme_rankings.why_now: 인지노동 다음은 물리노동. 2027~2030 진정한 텐베거 가능 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 상용화 시점 불확실. 미래 옵션밸류 비중 큼. 변동성 극심.

theme_rankings.why_now: 강한 추세장에서만 사용. 분할매수 + 손절선 명확히 + 자산의 5~10% 이하.
theme_rankings.risk: 장기 보유 ❌. 횡보·하락장에선 음의 복리(volatility decay)로 손실 누적.

top_news.title: Gold Fields Said to Mull Sweeter Northern Star Bid With Cash
top_news.summary: Gold Fields Ltd. is considering a sweetened takeover bid for Northern Star Resources Ltd., according to people familiar with the matter, as the South African miner seeks to overcome resistance to a deal that would create the world’s second-largest gold producer.

top_news.title: Can Treasury Yields Hit 6%?
top_news.summary: Bloomberg MLIV strategist Mark Cranfield warns 10-year Treasury yields could climb to 6% as Federal Reserve policy, elevated oil prices, and geopolitical tensions maintain upward pressure. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Sept. 30
top_news.summary: Oil steadied after its biggest drop in more than a week on signs Middle East supply has risen to near pre-war levels after Saudi Arabia resumed flows through a pipeline that avoids the Strait of Hormuz.

top_news.title: Trump Sued Over Move to Claw Back Federal Funds Set to Expire
top_news.summary: A White House plan to cut hundreds of millions of dollars in federal funding approved by Congress using a controversial budgeting maneuver faces a legal challenge on the eve of the end of the fiscal year, when the money is set to expire.

top_news.title: Paramount Deal Delay Fuels Fears of Costly $52 Billion M&A Debt
top_news.summary: Paramount Skydance Corp. has been talking to investors for months about the debt it’s selling to fund its Warner Bros. Discovery buyout, only to find that the longer it’s been forced to talk, the more it has to pay.

top_news.title: Nielsen CFO Jessica Holscott on Going Private & the Creator Economy
top_news.summary: Nielsen CFO Jessica Holscott discusses how private ownership has accelerated the company’s transformation, why its DoubleVerify acquisition expands Nielsen across the advertising workflow, and how Nielsen is working to create a standard measurement system for creators and digital content. Holscott and Bloomberg News Senior Editor Nina Trentmann join Businessweek Daily hosts Carol Massar and Tim Stenovec. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: There Are Some Chills in T-Bills
top_news.summary: The buyers’ strike expands in bonds.

top_news.title: Alaska Air CEO on Premium Offerings and New Lounges
top_news.summary: Alaska Airlines CEO Ben Minicucci sits down with Bloomberg's Romaine Bostick during the company's investor day to discuss the airline's foray into plush seats, new lounges in Seattle and Honolulu and international flights. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Torani CEO Melanie Dulbecco on Manufacturing, Company Culture
top_news.summary: Torani CEO Melanie Dulbecco joins Businessweek Daily in celebration of National Coffee Day. The 101-year-old flavor company has surpassed $800 million in annual revenue, continues to grow more than 20% year over year, and is approaching the $1 billion mark faster than anticipated, as changing beverage culture drives continued investment in U.S. manufacturing and its workforce. Dulbecco discusses the company's evolution with Bloomberg's Carol Massar and Tim Stenovec. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Paramount Loan Upsized by $2 Billion as Investor Demand Strong
top_news.summary: The loan portion of Paramount Skydance Corp.’s $52 billion debt package for its acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery Inc. was increased after it generated strong investor demand.
